prs.title: Retain last rendered size for auto-sizes images when unrendered
prs.author: noamr
prs.body:
When an image with `sizes="auto"` stops being rendered (such as being hidden via setting`display: none` on its parent etc), retain its last rendered width so that subsequent source selections do not fall back to viewport default or trigger wasteful fetches.

This last rendered width is sticky until the image is either re-rendered or removed.

Also, do not treat an auto-sizes image stopping being rendered as a relevant mutation.

Fixes #12712.

- [x] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed):
   * Chromium
   * Mozilla (already the ground truth apart from `moveBefore` behavior)
- [x] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at:
   * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/63095
- [x] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed:

   * Gecko: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2076675
   * WebKit: https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=325791

prs.title: Throw synchronously from string timer Trusted Types checks
prs.author: shannonbooth
prs.body: The timer initialization steps got a Trusted Types compliant string inside the timer task while being able to throw an exception.
